about_the_game:
Embark on an intergalactic adventure in StarBuddy, a colorful side-scrolling 3D platformer with a fresh twist. After your tiny spaceship enters a mysterious universe, your brave little hero sets out on a mission: rescue the adorable fluffy creatures and bring them safely back to their home planet.

Each level hides three unique fluffies in red, yellow, and blue. These lively creatures feel like vibrant versions of your white little hero, and it’s up to you to find and rescue them all. Once you gather every fluffy, hop back into your spaceship and travel to the next world!

Along the way, you’ll face a variety of enemies: colorful aliens, crawling robots, flying drones, and even factory machines that endlessly spawn enemies—until you shut down their production lines. Defeat them by jumping on their heads, blasting with your tiny blaster, or even unleashing a bazooka for maximum puff!

From lush green fields to scorching deserts, neon-lit cities, icy snowlands, and beyond—every stage offers a unique challenge and atmosphere. Keep an eye out for colorful balloons floating around; some carry hidden rewards to aid your journey.

⭐ Key Features

  • 🎮 Fresh Platforming Gameplay – A side-scrolling 3D platformer with depth and new mechanics

  • 🐾 Rescue the Fluffies – Collect the red, yellow, and blue companions in every level

  • 💥 Dynamic Combat – Jump on foes, blast with a blaster, or fire a bazooka

  • 🤖 Challenging Enemies – Colorful aliens, ground robots, flying drones, and enemy factories

  • 🌍 Diverse Worlds – Explore forests, deserts, cities, icy landscapes, and more

  • 🎈 Secrets & Rewards – Pop colorful balloons to discover hidden surprises

  • 🚀 Level Progression – Gather fluffies, return to your ship, and journey to the next adventure

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel i3 / AMD
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 / AMD Radeon HD 7770/ Intel UHD
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Standard onboard
pc_requirements.recommended:

  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel i5/ AMD Ryzen 5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 Ti / AMD RX 560
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Standard onboard
